continuation.summary: Commit 2d0c435269b7ff04ebc4cdacad06902334bd31b0 completed contact-metadata validation. All 124 immutable tests and 114 autonomous regressions pass. A remaining trust-boundary gap exists in verified_keys handling: Python membership permits strings, lists, tuples, and dictionaries to act as verification containers. For example, verified_keys='email' or {'email': False} can produce verified_candidate even though neither is a valid verified-key set. The classifier also accepts sets containing malformed nonstring keys. Validate the verification container before candidate classification while preserving all completed safeguards.: Only set and frozenset containers containing exclusively string keys may authorize verified_candidate mappings. Invalid containers or nonstring members must return human_review with reason invalid_verified_keys and expose no candidate or answer data. Valid empty containers must retain unverified_profile_fact behavior. Valid verified-key sets must preserve existing contact mappings. Preserve ambiguity, metadata, contact-type, unknown-question, and unsupported-control safeguards. Append autonomous regressions without replacing existing coverage. Modify only the two approved files, preserve immutable Git blob identity, and independently pass all ten mandatory test cases before commit. No network, private data, applications, deployment, publication, or automatic merge.
